summary: Frontend-only SIMULATION-mode testing of SUNMI D3 Mini (iter356) 'Caja' tab in Admin Inventory. All 6 features verified end-to-end with cookie-based admin auth. No bugs found.
verified_features: Caja tab (data-testid=inventory-tab-print) opens inventory-print-view with mode banner, config panel, test actions and recent-sales list.

Simulación mode: 'Ticket de prueba' -> POST /api/admin/pos/receipt/sample+build returns receipt; print-preview-dialog shows monospaced paper (809 chars) containing business name 'Resilience Brothers', items, and 'TOTAL'. Toast 'Ticket generado (simulación)' displayed.
ESC/POS hex dump (print-escpos-hex) renders inside expandable <details> (2393 chars, starts with '1b 40 1b 61 01 1b 45 01 1d 21 11 ...').
'Abrir gaveta' (print-open-drawer-btn) in simulation triggers toast 'Gaveta (simulación): pulso ESC/POS generado'.
SUNMI transport: print-ws-url input revealed; banner updates to 'Modo SUNMI: ... PENDIENTE DE VERIFICACIÓN FÍSICA en la T1730 (impresora + gaveta).' (did NOT trigger print as instructed).
Paper width 80mm/58mm and drawer toggle interactive; config persisted in localStorage key 'rb_printer_config_v1' and survives reload (58mm active class retained).
15 recent sales listed; clicking first print-sale-btn-* opened preview dialog with that sale's data (Audit prod_iter254_98a0dc59, qty 1x25 CUP, TOTAL 25.00 CUP).
critical_code_review_comments: InventoryPrintTab.jsx: print-escpos-hex is nested inside a <details> element (collapsed by default). The data-testid works but automated tests must expand the <details> first — fine, just noting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter356 SUNMI printing frontend is fully working in simulation mode. SUNMI mode UI (WS URL + pending banner) is correctly gated; physical device verification pending once hardware is purchased. Backend already covered by pytest (12/12).
